audit_budget_matches.class_: documented upstream drift, independently reproduced by the audit
audit_budget_matches.detail: the audit recomputes the A-v1 budget from accept-all trajectories and obtains a different value from the recorded batch because scenario_saa.py changed after that batch; the audit value equals the producer value, so the audit reproduces the drift rather than contradicting the run. The producer already records this as a diagnostic instead of a gate, and both panel arms share the recomputed budget.
